name: Palworld ARM64 - Pterodactyl
author: admin@ballaual.de
description: Palworld Dedicated Server for ARM64 Pterodactyl/Hydrodactyl using FEX-Emu. Primary game port is synchronized automatically to the server's primary allocation. Steam authentication defaults to false for ARM64/FEX compatibility.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

ROOT="/mnt/server"
DD="/opt/depotdownloader/DepotDownloader"
STEAM_SEED="/opt/steamcmd-seed"
APP_ID="${SRCDS_APPID:-2394010}"

step() {
    echo ""
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "  $1"
    echo "============================================================"
}

fatal() {
    echo "[FATAL] $1"
    exit "${2:-1}"
}

step "[1/5] Checking ARM64 Environment"
echo "Architecture : $(uname -m)"
echo "Kernel       : $(uname -r)"
df -h "${ROOT}" || true

case "$(uname -m)" in
    aarch64|arm64) ;;
    *) fatal "This egg requires an ARM64/aarch64 node." 10 ;;
esac

[[ -x "${DD}" ]] || fatal "Native ARM64 DepotDownloader is missing from the custom image." 11

step "[2/5] Preparing Pterodactyl Server Volume"
mkdir -p \
    "${ROOT}/backups" \
    "${ROOT}/logs/palworld" \
    "${ROOT}/.steamcmd" \
    "${ROOT}/Steam" \
    "${ROOT}/tmp" \
    "${ROOT}/.cache" \
    "${ROOT}/.config" \
    "${ROOT}/.local/share" \
    "${ROOT}/Pal/Saved/Config/LinuxServer"

step "[3/5] Installing Palworld Dedicated Server (App 2394010)"
ARGS=(
    -app "${APP_ID}"
    -os linux
    -osarch 64
    -dir "${ROOT}"
    -validate
)

if [[ -n "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ]]; then
    ARGS+=(-branch "${SRCDS_BETAID}")
fi
if [[ -n "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ]]; then
    ARGS+=(-branchpassword "${SRCDS_BETAPASS}")
fi

"${DD}" "${ARGS[@]}"

PALSERVER="${ROOT}/Pal/Binaries/Linux/PalServer-Linux-Shipping"
[[ -f "${PALSERVER}" ]] || fatal "Palworld executable was not downloaded to ${PALSERVER}" 12
chmod 0755 "${PALSERVER}" || true

step "[4/5] Seeding Writable SteamCMD"
if [[ ! -x "${ROOT}/.steamcmd/steamcmd.sh" ]]; then
    cp -a "${STEAM_SEED}/." "${ROOT}/.steamcmd/"
    chmod 0755 "${ROOT}/.steamcmd/steamcmd.sh"
fi
[[ -x "${ROOT}/.steamcmd/steamcmd.sh" ]] || fatal "SteamCMD seed failed." 13

step "[5/5] Final Verification"
echo "Palworld Binary : ${PALSERVER}"
echo "SteamCMD Path   : ${ROOT}/.steamcmd/steamcmd.sh"
df -h "${ROOT}" || true
echo ""
echo "[OK] Installation completed successfully without package manager overhead."

variables.name: Banner Title
variables.description: Custom title text displayed in the startup console banner.

variables.name: Startup Console Message
variables.description: Custom message displayed when starting the Palworld manager.

variables.name: Enable Color Logs
variables.description: Enable colored text and formatted section boxes in console logs.

variables.name: Quiet Monitoring (Anti-Spam Logs)
variables.description: Suppresses 10-second REST polling spam and Sentry cURL debug headers while keeping player join/leave, server status, warnings, and errors fully visible.

variables.name: Console Language / Idioma do Console
variables.description: Language for console logs and status indicators. Options: pt (Português), en (English), raw (Unfiltered technical logs).

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name displayed in the Palworld server browser.

variables.name: Server Description
variables.description: Description displayed by the server.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional password players must enter to join.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Palworld admin password. CHANGE THIS before opening server to public.

variables.name: Maximum Players
variables.description: Maximum player limit for the manager.

variables.name: Server Player Max Num
variables.description: Value written to ServerPlayerMaxNum in Palworld configuration.

variables.name: Public IP
variables.description: Optional public IP/hostname advertised by Palworld. Leave blank for automatic detection. Game port is synchronized automatically to primary Pterodactyl allocation.

variables.name: Query Port — EXTRA Allocation
variables.description: Steam server-browser/query port. Add ONE extra UDP allocation to this server and set this to that allocation's port for full query visibility. Direct game connections use the primary allocation automatically.
